title: Introduce prompt-regression-catalog and weighted-alert-fusion CI adapter
author: Marina Chen
description: Motivation: multiple recent regressions were noisy because CI treated every failing prompt-set equally; teams requested a way to (1) record canonical prompt-set metadata (route, owner, severity, expected baseline), (2) compute a fused alert score that weights different eval signals and cohorts, and (3) attach a tunable delay/soft-fail window so transient flaps don't block merges. This PR introduces a lightweight prompt-regression catalog plus a weighted-alert-fusion CI adapter that emits a single decision signal for PR gating. Changes include: a YAML catalog schema and loader, a fusion algorithm that combines precision/recall/regression delta signals with cohort weights and severity multipliers, a CI hook config and runner integration that posts back a structured decision, and a small exporter that surfaces catalog-derived metrics to the Console. Checklist: - [x] Define prompt-regression-catalog schema and validation - [x] Implement weighted-alert-fusion algorithm with smoothing and decay - [x] Add unit + integration tests for fusion logic and CI hook - [x] Hook CI adapter into existing smoke-eval workflow (soft-fail support) - [x] Update docs and add a short Console exporter for catalog metrics - [x] Add migration script to convert legacy prompt tag blobs to catalog entries Non-goals: this PR does not change evaluation metrics, it only re-weights/aggregates them for CI decisions. Design notes: - Catalog entries include: id, route_pattern, owner, severity (low/medium/high), baseline_metric, cohort_tags, mute_windows, and suggested_thresholds. - Fusion policy uses an exponential recency weight on recent eval runs, normalizes different metric scales via z-score using running baselines, multiplies by severity factor (high=2.0, medium=1.0, low=0.5) and then applies cohort attenuation to reduce alert weight for noisy cohorts. - CI adapter supports two outcomes: PASSED (fused_score < pass_threshold) and SOFT_FAIL (pass_threshold <= fused_score < hard_threshold). SOFT_FAIL can be configured to allow automatic retries/backoff before converting to HARD_FAIL. Migration: added a small helper script that scans legacy prompt tags and synthesizes minimal catalog YAML entries with conservative defaults. Rollout plan: feature flagged; default behavior for existing repos is unchanged until catalog entries are added. Backwards compatibility: adapter falls back to legacy per-prompt gating when no catalog entry is available.

review_comments: Aisha Patel: Can we add an E2E smoke test that exercises SOFT_FAIL->HARD_FAIL transition under flapping conditions? I saw a possible race in ci_hook where repeated runs will re-use the same window.
Marina Chen (author): Added an integration that simulates flapping in tests/integration/test_ci_adapter_end_to_end.py and ensured the hook uses a monotonic run id to avoid races; see second commit.
Daniel Kim: The attenuation parameters look reasonable by default but allow runtime tuning via config would be helpful. Also please ensure metrics emitted include per-cohort z-scores for debugging.
Marina Chen: Exposed attenuation and severity multipliers in ci/config/weighted_alert_hook.yaml and added catalog_metrics_exporter to surface per-cohort z-scores in the Console dashboard.
Sofia Marquez: Small nit: loader.py should validate owner email and surface clear warnings when baseline is missing. Also add a migration dry-run mode.
Marina Chen: loader now validates owner format and prints actionable warnings; migration script includes --dry-run flag.
ci_summary: CI pipeline: unit (pass), lint (pass), integration (pass on run #3 after flapping test stabilized). One transient timeout on integration in first run; rerun succeeded.
release_notes: Adds a prompt-regression catalog and a weighted-alert-fusion CI adapter. Introduces soft-fail windows for eval-driven PR gating and Console metrics for per-cohort z-scores. Feature-flagged; no behavioral changes until catalogs are populated.
notes_for_operators: When onboarding, populate catalog/prompt_regression_catalog.yaml or use migrations/legacy_prompt_tag_migration.py. Monitor fused_score and per-cohort z-scores on the prompt-regression Console dashboard; tune severity multipliers to match product risk appetite.
example_catalog_entry:
- id: billing_chargeback_v1
  route_pattern: "/v1/billing/chargeback*"
  owner: billing-team@redwood.ai
  severity: high
  baseline_metric: topk_accuracy@0.8
  cohort_tags: [large_amounts, edge_currency]
  suggested_thresholds: {pass: 0.6, soft_fail: 0.9, hard_fail: 1.2}
risk_and_mitigation: Risk: incorrect severity mappings could suppress important regressions or over-block changes. Mitigation: conservative defaults (most legacy prompts set to medium), feature flag rollout, and monitoring to revert or adjust multipliers quickly.
testing_notes: Added unit tests for normalization and attenuation. Integration simulates 30 rolling evals with injected noise to ensure soft-fail hysteresis prevents flapping. Benchmarks show fusion hook adds ~12ms median overhead per eval run in CI stub environment.
